mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the balance organs to the body was most worthwhile: the final picture showed how the sensors help keep the eyes steady and adjust posture.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the two sensor types felt mostly like an assembly step; it showed where they sit but added less about how they work.

surprise.text: The weighted sensors respond not just to tilt but also to changes in straight-line movement.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though connecting the body to the response routes before adding the sensors felt like a required assembly order rather than a meaningful choice.

continue.text: I would try another chapter: the clear connection from sensor movement to a useful body response made me curious what comes next, even though several later steps were the only offered action.
